guidance: place_edit.py carries add_text (board-frame silk text, idempotent) and move_text (refdes/value field repositioning) ops - S14 closed the V17 gap. Labels must be PIN-LOCKED (a label readable against the wrong pin is worse than none); footprint-INTERNAL silk defects are librarian edits (approval + lib/EDITS.md), not board text.
A silk collision may also be fixed by nudging the FOOTPRINT via place_edit within placement legality.
Verify with check_silk.py, the drc_routed gate (err+warn includes silk), and a render of the region READ back.

violations.msg: No hot-surface legend anywhere on a board whose entire top copper IS the radiator. At the design point the tab copper sits near 95 C and the pour runs 65-80 C across most of the top face, so there is no cool place for a user to hold it; requirements.md s.8 records this as a live bench hazard ('typically 80-110 C surface'). The top silk carries only the terminal legend and refdes, and the bottom silk is completely empty. One gr_text on the empty bottom copper or beside U1 costs nothing and is not an excluded feature class (block-only excludes 'indicators', i.e. LEDs, not legend). Waivable: requirements s.8 rules the HAZARD out of scope, which is about the hazard rather than about labelling it - the human decides.

scope: fix ONLY these violations; do not touch unrelated nets/regions; re-run the failed gate when done
